entries.entry_name: Heavy Attack — Guardian of the Flame
entries.mitigation: Block the telegraphed heavy attack; an unblocked hit can knock the target away and create unnecessary recovery pressure.
Keep Iceheart faced away from the group and block or step out of the frontal cone.
Move out of the frost circles under players, then clear the ice skeletons created when the eruptions resolve.
Break free immediately when Drodda begins draining you; the channel heals her, so preserve enough stamina to escape it.
Control and clear the low-health frost atronachs before add pressure accumulates around the group.
Tank or control the returning spirit panthers rather than repeatedly chasing them for kills while Longclaw remains active.
Step out of the small ground attacks and poison clouds while maintaining pressure on Longclaw.
Bash Foulhide as soon as the red interrupt telegraph appears.
After the group is pulled toward center, move out of the large damage circle as soon as the web releases you.
Keep Selene faced away from the group; the tank blocks or sidesteps the large frontal spirit attack without turning it through allies.
Block Snagg gro-Mashul's heavy uppercut and step outside his short whirlwind when it begins.
Move sideways out of Nusana's line of fire rather than remaining in its path.
Interrupt Dynus Aralas when he begins an interruptible elemental channel.
Move out of the Incineration Beetles' pulsing fire and ground effects while clearing the wave.

entries.entry_name: Troll King Slam — The Beast Master
entries.mitigation: Stay reasonably close to limit long jumps, then block or step out of the Troll King's slam.
Kill the atronachs when their beams make the Lava Queen immune, then return damage to the boss.

entries.entry_name: Lava Queen Heavy Attack — The Lava Queen
entries.mitigation: Block the heavy attack promptly to avoid the large hit and knockback.
